semantics.readonly_rule: Default is read-only; edits create candidate composition.
semantics.identity_rule: Domain, module, primitive, instance and rule identities remain distinct.
semantics.action_rule: compose/rebind/validate/apply/migrate operations use separate authorized workflows.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing/composing Domain grants no underlying module/data authority.
semantics.graph_rule: Composition edges correspond only to explicit refs.

invariants.rule: Composition never silently transfers semantic ownership: universal modules own their primitives, domains own their composition semantics, and composed members retain their own identities and contracts.

Containment, relation, dependency, composition and projection edges exist only through explicit typed references; naming, file hierarchy, UI adjacency or shared values never create semantic structure.
